style.styleTitle: Personalised Nutcracker Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of festive magic to your Christmas tree with our Personalised Nutcracker Christmas Glass Bauble. Crafted from glass, this enchanting bauble features a beautifully detailed Nutcracker design, capturing the charm and whimsy of the holiday season. Personalise the bauble with a name up to 12 characters, to appear in fixed UPPERCASE. Bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. Colour of Ribbon May Vary. The style of bauble topper may vary. Great for Christmas!
